issues.summary: Missing mandatory fail-loud export gate for enabled pitchAxis; enabled configs could export silently through the unchanged linear exporter, violating binding rule 3.
issues.fix: CNBLilypond.generate() now throws PITCH_AXIS_GATE_MESSAGE (exported constant naming E13-1/E13-2, the cnb:get-pitch-staff-position hook, and spec v1.3 §8a) on config.pitchAxis?.enabled, before any other validation. CNBConfigExport.validateForExport() surfaces the identical text as a blocking error (parity contract). Tests: 3 in cnb-lilypond-tests.js, 1 parity test in cnb-config-export-tests.js. Session 3 still owns the §8 checks 8–12 additions and the gate's verified removal.

issues.summary: Inverse-candidate contract overstated as 0/1/2 entries; legal PA-W1 / PA-8-boundary-equality maps can produce 3+ candidates at one absolute axis position.
issues.fix: semisAtPosition doc comment and the session notes now state candidate arrays of ANY length (0 none / 1 one-to-one / 2 shared / 3+ on touching or overlapping octave bands). Added a boundary-equality test (map [0,0,1,2,2,3,3,4,5,5,6,7], stride 7, positions[11] === positions[0] + stride): semisAtPosition(7) -> [11,12,13], nearestSemisForY returns the trio, range-end clipping [23,24].
